generations.name: Third generation (F56) Electric
generations.notes: Cooper SE 3-door (EPA "Cooper SE Hardtop 2 door"), 32.6 kWh gross / 28.9 kWh usable, 50 kW DC, 7.4 kW AC. The 2025+ J01 Cooper Electric is built in China and is not sold in Canada or the US (100 % tariffs), so no later generation is listed; if MINI imports it later, add a "j01" generation. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mini_Electric ; https://www.motoringfile.com/2024/11/14/exclusive-mini-usa-will-not-import-the-j01-electric-mini-cooper-aceman-in-the-near-future/ ; https://jalopnik.com/mini-wont-be-bringing-the-new-electric-cooper-and-acema-1851703592
